item.title: From zero to 1,000: How Amazon Leo built one of the world's largest satellite production lines
item.description: Amazon has built more than 1,000 satellites for its growing constellation—and it's just getting started.

item.title: How AWS is helping companies build physical AI machines that think
item.description: Amazon launched the Physical AI Toolchain on AWS, an open-source stack that helps manufacturers build machines that perceive, reason, and act in the real world.
